title: Kayaking 3 Hr Canyon & Cliffside on Saguaro Lake
includes: Single sit on top Kayak (NO doubles) or Paddleboard, Life Jacket, Paddle
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Under 18 must be accompanied by an adult
Dress to be in the heat/cold and to get wet!
Participant must be comfortable with an unguided water excursion
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore Saguaro Lake! Whether you’re a beginner or expert you can experience the beautiful lakes of Arizona! You will be given an orientation of basic safety and paddling instruction. Along with some suggestions on fun places to paddle and how far for a given time length of rental. After that, it's just you and the beautiful scenery of where the desert meets the water!
